changes: Authenticated bank customers generate their own WeChat QR directly inside the IM page; no operations login, popup or redirect.
In-page status, optional provider verification code, phone confirmation and explicit bank binding confirmation.
Five-minute owner-scoped QR attempts, generation quota, safe cancellation and duplicate confirmation handling.
Fresh QR login excludes existing customer credential hints; a private chat already owned by another bank customer cannot be overwritten.
Existing manual pairing codes, WeCom private-chat binding and reminders remain available.
verificationNotes: Published assets rendered a generated fixture QR and completed the same-page lifecycle with all bank, IM and Agent requests intercepted in the browser; this is not a real WeChat handshake.

The first production-browser run timed out waiting for the full remote load event on a later page reload. The full regression was rerun with DOMContentLoaded navigation and a 45-second navigation limit.
Real provider login requires the authenticated customer to click Generate QR, scan with their own WeChat and explicitly confirm the bank binding.
limits: Only WeChat QR login is exposed to bank customers; operations management remains separately authorized.
A new WeChat login needs a private message to ClawBot to establish the current delivery context.
Customer Agent restart clears in-memory bank sessions; this release does not restore them or migrate existing bindings.
Existing database failure protection and separate financial-operation confirmation remain in force.
